lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Regina Cruz is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Regina Cruz is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Regina kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Regina's gone." Alfredo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Regina." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Elena blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Regina Cruz, 41 days. The mantle passes to Elena Ocampo.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Elena Ocampo, 63 — a zookeeper. Her hands know different work now: Night Eyes.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Regina — and Regina is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Alfredo, Ernst, Valentina and 3 more speak for Elena — "Regina trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Elena before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
